verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes a REST API and an OpenAPI spec that cover model endpoints under /v1/accounts. The docs also say the API lets you "automate management of models." Its inference endpoint is described as OpenAI-compatible. However, no evidence item explicitly documents a GET /v1/models-style list operation that returns the live serverless catalog, so the enumeration capability is only implied. missing for 10: an explicitly documented list-models (GET /v1/models) endpoint, evidence that it returns the live public catalog rather than only account-owned models, hands-on or independent confirmation of agent enumeration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint

citations.quote: covering /v1/accounts, deployment, model and training endpoints
It also lets you automate management of models, deployments, datasets, and more.
Fireworks provides an OpenAI compatible endpoint.
